data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to log Facebook App Events for ad measurement and attribution.
data.what_it_does: Provides a 1:1 wrapper around Meta’s Facebook App Events SDK, allowing apps to log custom events, purchases, and handle consent on Android and iOS.
use_when: Need to track app events for Facebook ads measurement
Want to build audiences or measure ad performance
Require a native SDK with 1:1 API mapping
avoid_when: Not using Facebook or Meta for analytics
Need a lightweight solution without native configuration
strengths: Built‑in consent handling and SDK initialization control
weaknesses: Requires native configuration in Android and iOS
Limited to Facebook App Events only
data.setup_notes: Add app id, client token and URL scheme strings in Android strings.xml and AndroidManifest.xml; add corresponding keys in iOS Info.plist; set iOS deployment target to 15.0; optionally disable auto‑init for consent flow.
